description: 'She's sleeping.' 'She's just gone down for a nap.' 'She's had a big day.' Four calls, four times. When the daughter finally visits unannounced her mother asks why she stopped ringing.
energy_note: Her mother thinks she stopped calling.

description: Victims of elder abuse are three times more likely to be at risk of premature death, four times more likely to be admitted to a nursing home, and three times more likely to be hospitalised.
energy_note: Three times more likely to die sooner.
